plan.title: Add Surrogate Bid on Tech+RFQ RFQ Stage

steps.note: Open the existing Tech+RFQ project's RFQ Participants screen.
Enable surrogate bids as required by the case.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the tenant.
Add the buyer-entered surrogate bid for Vendor A on the RFQ stage.
Verify that the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Verify the RFQ responses identify at least one submitted response as a surrogate bid.
Open Master QCS to inspect the bid ranking.
Verify the submitted bid is ranked in the Master QCS grid.
